resolved_conflicts.explanation: The brief said sources give different build years. The sources read agree on 1960 (NHLR build field and the directory row); NHLR's description says construction ran 1959 and 1960 on Tiptop Mountain.
The 2016 annual report expected fire staffing; the later directory lists the tower as unmanned. The directory is used as current status.

notes_for_editor: The link between the Tiptop tower's 2016 buyer (a Fire Lookout Association member planning a family ranch on the Imnaha River) and the Long Ridge site is inferred. No source states it outright, so the story says so; the buyer is not named in the story. The 2016 Lookout Network item is only known second-hand through cherylhill.net; the original was not read. The facebook post from Oregon Department of Forestry about Long Ridge was not read (not cached). Height is not in any source read, so height_m is omitted. Access: a fire lookout listing says private, no public access; the NHLR has no access note. Photo candidates not added: NHLR and firelookout.com both credit a 2016 photo to Rex Kamstra, licence unknown, no image URL retrieved. Record's agency 'Land Owner' is kept as 'Private landowner' in facts.
